title: University of Amsterdam Scholarships
program_type: University scholarship programmes for international students (Amsterdam Merit Scholarship plus faculty-specific schemes)
description: The University of Amsterdam runs several scholarship programmes for talented and motivated international students, published from one official Fees and funding hub. The flagship is the Amsterdam Merit Scholarship for outstanding students from outside the EU/EEA planning a Master's programme at the UvA. Each faculty also runs its own scholarships for international Master's students, covering Economics and Business, Humanities, Law, Science and Social and Behavioural Sciences, and a separate set of Bachelor's scholarships exists. title: Tulī Takes Flight Scholarships
program_type: Government-funded scholarship for Pacific students, administered by the Pacific Education Foundation
description: Tulī Takes Flight scholarships are funded by the New Zealand Ministry of Education and administered by the Pacific Education Foundation to reduce financial barriers to tertiary study and vocational training for Pacific people. They form part of the government's gesture of goodwill and reconciliation to Aotearoa Pacific communities following its 2021 apology for the Dawn Raids. Awards can be made for either vocational or academic study and can run for one, two or three years. title: New Zealand Space Scholarship
official_source: Ministry of Business, Innovation and Employment (MBIE), New Zealand Space Agency
program_type: Government-funded postgraduate research internship placement abroad (not a degree programme)
duration: 3-month internship, July to September 2027 (dates subject to change)
description: The New Zealand Space Scholarship gives postgraduate STEM students a fully supported three-month internship at NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory in Southern California, working alongside scientists and engineers on space missions and research. Applications for the 2027 scholarship opened on 1 October 2026 and the internship runs from July to September 2027. The scholarship covers return economy flights to the United States, accommodation, a daily living allowance and reasonable travel-related expenses including insurance support where applicable. title: Aotearoa New Zealand Tāwhia te Mana Research Fellowships — New Zealand Mana Tūāpapa Future Leader Fellowship
description: The Mana Tūāpapa Future Leader Fellowship is the early-career scheme within the Aotearoa New Zealand Tāwhia te Mana Research Fellowships, administered by Royal Society Te Apārangi on behalf of the Ministry of Business, Innovation and Employment. It funds employed researchers within 0-4 years of research experience after PhD conferral to build the foundations of an independent research career. Around 20 fellowships are awarded each year, each worth NZ$820,000 over four years, made up of salary contribution, institutional overheads and research expenses. title: Rhodes Scholarship for New Zealand
official_source: Universities New Zealand – Te Pōkai Tara
duration: Up to three years of postgraduate study at the University of Oxford
description: The Rhodes Scholarship for New Zealand is a partnership between the Rhodes Trust and the Robertson Foundation, administered in New Zealand by Universities New Zealand – Te Pōkai Tara. It supports outstanding all-round students to undertake postgraduate study at the University of Oxford, United Kingdom. Up to three scholars are elected from New Zealand each year, and the Scholarship covers fees, accommodation and living costs for up to three years. Applicants must be New Zealand citizens or hold a New Zealand Permanent Resident Visa and must meet an age and undergraduate GPA requirement.

title: Ngarimu VC and 28th (Māori) Battalion Memorial Scholarships
official_source: Ngarimu VC and 28th (Māori) Battalion Memorial Scholarship Fund Board — Ministry of Education
duration: Up to 3 years (undergraduate); up to 2 years (master's); up to 2 years (doctoral)
description: The Ngarimu VC and 28th (Māori) Battalion Memorial Scholarships are annual awards funded by the Ngarimu VC and 28th (Māori) Battalion Memorial Scholarship Fund Board, established in 1945, and administered through the Ministry of Education. They are awarded to exceptional Māori students for vocational or tertiary study who demonstrate values aligned with those of the 28th (Māori) Battalion. Following a $100,000 per year increase from the 2026-27 Budget, 14 scholarships are awarded each year across five schemes: 5 VET, 4 undergraduate, 3 master's, 1 Master of Education research and 1 doctoral. title: University of Auckland Top Achiever Scholarship
description: The University of Auckland Top Achiever Scholarship is an annual University of Auckland award that recognises and rewards students with excellent academic records and demonstrated leadership potential enrolling full-time in the first year of an undergraduate degree. Up to 250 awards are made each year, each worth up to $27,000 in total, comprising one year of catered accommodation in a University of Auckland Hall of Residence plus $5,000. Applications for the 2027 round opened on 20 May 2026 and closed at midday on 12 August 2026.
